purpose: Per-episode wall-clock budget. tools/throughput_baseline_gate.py measures an episode from its orchestrator run logs (+ TIME_LEDGER) and FAILS when a budget is exceeded. Waiting time is never excluded: every second between the first run start and the last run end lands in exactly one bucket.

measurement.window: first orchestrator run start -> last orchestrator run end (pipeline_logs/<EP>/run_*.log)

buckets.HUMAN_AUTH_WAIT: gap after a run that ended needing the line owner (DRY_PLANNED / PAID_STEPS_DISABLED / paid authority / cap / AWAITING_ROGER)
buckets.PROVIDER_RENDER_WAIT: gap after a run that ended BLOCKED on *_NOT_ALL_COMPLETED (provider still rendering)
buckets.PROVIDER_SUBMIT: in-run time inside submit_* / paid bgm generate commands
buckets.CC_REVIEW_WAIT: gap after a run that ended REVIEW_REQUIRED (machine review answered by the agent)
buckets.CC_FIX_WAIT: gap after a run that ended BLOCKED on anything else (agent fixing contracts / gates / tools)
buckets.PIPELINE_COMPUTE: in-run time inside every other child command
buckets.RUN_OVERHEAD: in-run time not covered by a child command
buckets.UNATTRIBUTED_IDLE: gap after a run that ended PASS or with no recorded blocker

target.stage_span_definition: first run in which the stage reported a result -> the run in which it first reported PASS (or the last run if never PASS); overlapping spans are allowed, so the per-stage sum may exceed the window

rationale.human: one pre-authorised batch order per episode (3a) + S8 viewing; E12 spent 34.45 h on 15 separate paid launches / DRY_PLANNED stops
rationale.provider: E12 render waits summed 27.3 h over 18 posted waves because waves were serialised on the orchestrator re-entry; overlapping rolling waves with max_remote_inflight bound them to the longest chain, not the sum
rationale.cc_llm: 1033 review items at the measured median of 80 s/item = 23 h serial; 4 parallel unit-scoped review workers (3b) -> 5.7 h, plus 5.4 h measured pipeline compute; E12 also lost 127 h to CC_FIX_WAIT, which is removed by pre-paid proxy checks (3c), not by budget
rationale.idle: the unattended runner (run_unattended.sh) re-enters every 20 min, so no PASS/idle gap exceeds that cadence

enforcement.when: S7-SYNC / line_upgrade_gate close for the episode; exit 1 = over budget
enforcement.ci: tools/tests/test_throughput_baseline_gate.py (synthetic logs) is in PORTABLE_CORE_MANIFEST portable_test_modules; the real-episode measurement needs runtime evidence and is not a clean-clone test
